title: Rendition
description: One downloadable form of an asset. original = uploaded bytes, unmodified; web = longest side <= 2000 px JPEG; square = web centred on a white square canvas; thumb = longest side <= 600 px JPEG.

url.description: Download URL. Either short-lived signed (usable without Authorization until url_expires_at) or requiring the Bearer token. Never a permanent public URL. Clients MUST treat it as opaque.

content_type.description: Media type. 'original' keeps the uploaded type; web/square/thumb are image/jpeg.
